mentions.name: waclaw
mentions.description: Self-hosted WhatsApp router named waclaw that lets you host many OpenClaw instances behind a single WhatsApp Business account, acting as a proxy that routes inbound messages to the OpenClaw instance associated with each phone number. Built on a simple Bun + SQLite stack.
mentions.source_excerpt: A self-hosted WhatsApp router for fleets of OpenClaws, called waclaw. It lets you host many OpenClaw instances behind a single WhatsApp Business account, acting as a "proxy" that routes the inbound messages to the OpenClaw instance associated to that phone number.
